neighbours.label: a digit of a person's age, in any wording, as against other numbers in the same place
fire: In 1760, aged 24, she left the island.
He died at age 63 after a short illness.
At age 17 he joined the navy.
Maria, 38, runs a bakery in Lima.
The suspect, a man aged 45, was arrested.
She won the title at age 19 in Oslo.
Aged 52, he sold the farm and moved.
John Hale, 71, has lived here for years.
quiet: In 1760, with 24 cows, she left the island.
He died in room 63 after a short illness.
On page 17 he names the navy.
The suspect, a man with 45 dollars, was arrested.
She won the title at table 19 in Oslo.
With 52 sheep, he sold the farm and moved.
John Hale has lived at number 71 for years.

notes: Second round. In the first round the near misses shared a 'when they were' lead-in and fired on it. Here the lead-ins differ and the near misses keep a number.
